plan.status: Second follow-up, written after the first follow-up results were seen. Extends RQ3 only; the frozen main study and the first follow-up are unchanged.
plan.code_holdout: Repeat the main-study non-code training / coding test experiment with seeds 1449 and 1450; seed 1448 is the frozen main-study fit. Same recipes and the same per-class matched mixed-domain control.
plan.writing_holdout: The assignment's own RQ3 example: train without creative writing (coding, math, factual and other prompts remain), validate on non-writing rows, test on the creative-writing subset of the test split. Creative writing is Arena category_tag creative_writing_v0.1.creative_writing. Mixed-domain control matched by per-class training count. Seeds 1448-1450.
plan.reporting: Target-domain macro-F1 for holdout and control, seed-averaged paired group-bootstrap interval for the difference (2,000 resamples, seed 1448), and per-class recall.
plan.no_selection: No recipe, epoch budget, or threshold changes; nothing is chosen with test labels.
